description: Turns MIDI notes generated by a hosted VST plugin into gates. It goes immediately to the right of a Host, Host-FX or Host-XL and takes the MIDI that module's plugin sends

outputs.text: 10V while the note assigned to it is held, or a 1ms trigger when note on and note off arrive together. Click its note in the display to change which note it answers

notes: nothing reaches the outputs unless the VST plugin in the Host module at the left sends MIDI out of its own, as a sequencer or an audio-to-pitch detector does
click the display to take MIDI from one channel of the plugin instead of all of them; the choice is on the display, not on the panel menu
these MIDI expanders can be chained, each one passing the MIDI on to the module at its right
menu: Velocity mode — sends the note's velocity as a voltage in place of a flat 10V
Panic — releases every note the module is holding at its outputs
